tieu_de: Uranus transit through the 1st house: becoming the person you actually are
mo: Will this transit end my relationship?
Why do I feel like a different person?
Is it a good time to move abroad or change careers?

Some transits change your circumstances. This one changes you, and the circumstances follow. When Uranus crosses into your 1st house, the old version of yourself starts to feel like a costume that no longer fits, and you notice it every time you get dressed, introduce yourself or explain what you do.
Friends may say you seem different before you can say how. That is normal. The 1st house is the most personal part of the chart, so the restlessness here is about identity first and logistics second.

doan: I Uranus is the planet of release, surprise and self-rule. In the 1st house it presses on the questions "Who am I when nobody is setting the terms?" and "Which parts of my life did I only choose to keep the peace?" The pull is toward independence, and it can be very strong.

This is not a mood that passes in a week. Over several years you are likely to revise how you look, how you carry yourself, the direction you give your life and the amount of personal space you insist on. Many people describe it afterwards as the period when they finally stopped asking permission.
Planet Uranus Rules Aquarius Innovation, freedom, surprise
The signs tend to be small at first and then pile up:
A sudden urge to cut or dye your hair, change your wardrobe or drop a style you wore for years.
Impatience with routines that others planned for you, from family traditions to office rituals.
A habit of saying "actually, no" in places where you used to go along.
Interest in a new field, a new city or a new way of living that seems to come out of nowhere.
People close to you reacting to the change before you have fully explained it.
You might also notice that you start things more abruptly than before. Plans get made at midnight and acted on by morning.

This transit gives you permission to be yourself on a scale that is hard to reach at other times. Patterns picked up from parents, old partners or early jobs lose their grip. If you have been living by a script, you can rewrite it now, and the new version tends to feel more honest and more alive.

It is also a good period for experiments with your image and presentation. A new name professionally, a different way of speaking up in meetings, a fresh look: these can stick because they match who you are becoming, not who you were told to be.

The danger is confusing novelty with freedom. Uranus can make any change feel urgent, and a decision made only to escape boredom can leave marks on the relationships you care about most. The choices you make now tend to be pivotal and hard to undo, so the gap between a genuine need and a passing itch matters a great deal.
Partners and close friends may feel pushed away if the change arrives as a sudden announcement instead of a conversation. Rebellion aimed at the wrong target costs more than it gains.

Uranus spends about 7 years in each sign, and a house transit usually runs on a similar scale, though house sizes vary with the house system and your birth latitude, so yours may be shorter or longer. If Uranus crosses your Ascendant at the start of this period, expect the first year or so to feel the most electric. After that, the change settles into a steady process of becoming.
Make the reversible changes quickly and the irreversible ones slowly. A haircut can grow back; a resignation letter cannot be unsent.
Before any big move, ask yourself what you are running toward, not only what you are running from.
Tell the people close to you what is shifting while it is shifting. Surprise is Uranus's style, but it does not have to be yours.
Give yourself a physical outlet for restlessness: a new sport, a new route to work, travel.
Keep a short list of the values you would not trade. Use it to test every "I need to change everything" impulse.

Not by itself. It raises your need for room, and relationships that can make room usually adapt well. Relationships built on you staying the same are the ones that feel strain. Talking early helps far more than acting suddenly.

Because in a practical sense you are becoming one. The 1st house is your self-image and the way you meet the world, and Uranus is updating both. The feeling of strangeness usually fades once your outer life catches up with the inner change.
It can be, especially if the idea has been building for a while. Uranus in the 1st favours bold personal moves. The test is whether the plan still makes sense after a few weeks of sleeping on it.
